# LocalCloud

LocalCloud provides 27 available Google Cloud service guides in one local Docker runtime. Availability does not imply full Google Cloud parity or default startup. Firestore is available but disabled by default; Google Sheets provides a limited read-only values facade.

LocalCloud is not a production replacement. Use is governed by the proprietary LocalCloud license; review the license before use. The proprietary Public Preview License permits individuals and organizations, including for-profit companies, to use LocalCloud free of charge for internal development, testing, CI, evaluation, and internal pilots. Excluded uses include customer-facing or other production use, reselling LocalCloud or providing it as a hosted or managed service, redistribution or sublicensing, modification except where applicable law requires permission.

## Quick start

```bash
curl -fsSL https://local.cloud/install.sh | sh
localcloud doctor
localcloud start
eval "$(localcloud env)"
localcloud console
```

## Runtime facts

- Default project: `local-gcp-project`
- Default user: `local-developer`
- Default data volume: `localcloud-data`
- CLI memory default: `4g`
- Health endpoint: `http://localhost:5380/health`
- Shell environment endpoint: `http://localhost:5380/env?format=shell`
- Terraform environment endpoint: `http://localhost:5380/env?format=terraform`

Trust URLs and endpoint values returned by the selected CLI runtime; occupied canonical ports may be remapped. Select durable storage with `--data-volume NAME`; project and caller remain request context. LocalCloud emulates bounded local development workflows. Validate application behavior against real Google Cloud before production deployment.

## Services
- Cloud Storage — supported; starts by default; HTTP/REST :5382; `STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5382`. Verified only for the documented bounded local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Pub/Sub — partial; starts by default; gRPC :5383; `PUBSUB_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5383`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Firestore — coming soon. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Bigtable — partial; starts by default; gRPC :5385; `BIGTABLE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5385`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Spanner — partial; starts by default; gRPC :5386 · HTTP/REST :5387; `SPANNER_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5386`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- BigQuery — supported; starts by default; HTTP/REST :5388 · gRPC :5389; `BIGQUERY_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5388`. Verified only for the documented bounded local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Google Sheets — partial; starts by default; HTTP/REST :5380; `SHEETS_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Secret Manager — partial; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `SECRET_MANAGER_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud Tasks — partial; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `CLOUD_TASKS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud Scheduler — partial; starts by default; grpc+rest :5380; `CLOUD_SCHEDULER_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud Functions (2nd Gen) — partial; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `CLOUD_FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- AlloyDB — partial; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `ALLOYDB_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Dataproc — coming soon. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud IAM — partial; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `IAM_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud Resource Manager — partial; starts by default; HTTP/REST :5380; `CLOUD_RESOURCE_MANAGER_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Service Usage — partial; starts by default; HTTP/REST :5380; `SERVICE_USAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud Billing — partial; starts by default; HTTP/REST :5380; `CLOUD_BILLING_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud Logging — partial; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `CLOUD_LOGGING_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud Monitoring — partial; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `CLOUD_MONITORING_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- GKE — partial; available but disabled by default; gRPC :5380 · k3d :5443; `GKE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Compute Engine — coming soon. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud Run — partial; available but disabled by default; gRPC :5380; `CLOUD_RUN_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Memorystore (Redis/Valkey) — partial; starts by default; RESP :5390; `REDIS_HOST=localhost:5390`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud Workflows — partial; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `WORKFLOWS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Vertex AI — coming soon. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud KMS — partial; starts by default; grpc+rest :5380; `CLOUD_KMS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
- Cloud SQL — partial; starts by default; HTTP/REST :5380 · PostgreSQL :5391 · MySQL :5406; `CLOUD_SQL_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380`. Partial local behavior with operation-specific limitations.
